values.note: The 9 RV sites are first come, first served and cannot be reserved. The 30 undesignated tent spaces book up to 60 days ahead online or by phone (licence plate required), which guarantees a space, not a particular site. The whole campground can be rented (reserved dates are listed on the page; September 11-13, 2026 was taken). Stays are limited to 14 nights in any 30 days. Check-in and check-out 2 PM.

note: Bismarck Parks and Recreation primitive campground on Hwy 1804 (10900 NW Highway 1804), nine miles north of Pioneer Park and just south of Double Ditch Indian Village State Historic Site, in a wooded park above the Missouri River. Enclosed picnic shelter on request, playground; the park stays open by day for walking and fishing. --Claude
